name: COMBINED_VIG_METER_RECALIBRATION

pressure.symmetry: thresholds are symmetric around neutral center 50

unmeasuredAgreementTreatment.rule: The LOW graphic branch is a conservative rendering fallback only. The terminal must visibly identify Agreement as UNMEASURED and must never describe the fallback branch as measured LOW agreement.
unmeasuredAgreementTreatment.reason: Preserves the existing 18-graphic architecture while eliminating false HIGH Agreement from zero-confidence fallback scores.

comparisonToCurrentProductionBaseline.interpretation: The recalibrated system uses one fewer state in this 85-report sample, but the states that do occur are substantially less concentrated. The purpose is truthful and useful distribution, not forcing all 18 graphics to appear.

selectionRationale.reason: 20/40 is preferred over the optimizer's 20/35 because it produces a materially cleaner Heat distribution, better entropy and lower distribution error, uses simpler round thresholds, and avoids lowering HIGH merely to populate one additional historically rare combination.

notes: This locks the Step 4 calibration decision only. The live terminal formulas, thresholds, labels, VIG graphics, and report history remain unchanged until Step 5.
Step 5 must implement all three locked meter formulas plus these thresholds as one coordinated production change and add regression coverage before the terminal is considered recalibrated.
